blockingEvidence: All five imported Canva/Pexels candidates are explicitly excluded from production and remain not rights-cleared.
No original MP4, exact source match, SHA-256 or human visual review is claimed for these excluded assets.
Reactivation requires full source provenance, local original media, hash verification, rights review and human visual approval.
notes: All five imported Canva/Pexels wildlife assets are quarantined as EXCLUDED_NOT_USED and retained for audit only. They are not original creator-captured media and are not cleared for any production use. The current production path requires genuine original creator-captured wildlife footage; neither generic stock footage nor AI-generated wildlife visuals may substitute for it.
historicalBlockingEvidence: The five Canva asset IDs and media metadata are recorded, but original MP4 files are not present in the repository.

Four candidate Pexels pages were checked against creator, dimensions and duration. Three match the recorded metadata; one zebra clip has a 1-second duration mismatch. Canva-to-Pexels visual matching remains pending because the source preview could not be independently retrieved in this verification pass.
The fifth Canva lion clip has no verified exact Pexels source page/creator; similar Pexels pages with mismatching durations or dimensions were rejected.

Candidate Pexels pages and general Pexels commercial-use terms are not sufficient to clear an imported clip without exact visual matching, original MP4, download/source evidence, hash and human review.
No footage rights or human visual review is marked complete.

currentProductionPolicy.note: Only genuine original creator-captured wildlife media with verified provenance, exact source files, hashes, commercial rights and human review may enter production.
